03 — Our approach

How the work runs.

A genuine sequence: each step is decided before the next begins, with reviewable progress at every stage.

  1. Map

    Map the workflow as it runs today, with the people who run it.

  2. Choose

    Choose the smallest automation that removes the most handoffs.

  3. Build

    Build with a human checkpoint wherever judgment is involved.

  4. Measure

    Measure the time given back, then extend to the next workflow.

05 — FAQ

The questions asked first.

Which tools do you build on?

We choose per engagement. The platforms your team already uses come first, then hosted AI models and orchestration tools that fit the data and privacy constraints of the work.

Will automation replace our staff?

It is designed to remove repetitive handoffs so people can do the work that needs judgment. Every workflow we build keeps a human checkpoint where decisions are made.

How do we start?

Book a consultation. We map one workflow with you, agree on scope, and propose a first build that can be reviewed within its first weeks.
